summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Lloyds Banking Group plc under the SEC Exchange Act, disclosing director/PDMR share transactions under the company's Share Incentive Plan. The filing reports monthly acquisitions of Partnership Shares and awards of Matching Shares by several executives on August 10, 2026, with share prices around GBP1.1515 per share. It contains no special-situations activity such as mergers, tenders, or strategic changes. It is a standard disclosure of insider share dealings, not a special situation.
